subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, relatos de experimentos, registros de observação, entrevistas, dentre outros gêneros do campo investigativo, que possam ser repassados oralmente por meio de ferramentas digitais, em áudio ou vídeo, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/ finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Planejar relatos de experimentos ou entrevistas para apresentação oral usando ferramentas digitais
components.description_en: Plan experiment reports or interviews for oral delivery using digital tools
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and publish a piece of writing

components.description_pt: Produzir gravações orais de gêneros investigativo-de-campo em formato áudio ou vídeo colaborativamente
components.description_en: Produce oral recordings of investigative-field genres in audio or video format collaboratively
components.cc_component_description: Create an audio recording of a story or poem for a specific purpose

components.description_pt: Adaptar conteúdo de textos investigativos à situação comunicativa e propósito da apresentação oral
components.description_en: Adapt content of investigative texts to the communicative situation and purpose of oral delivery
components.cc_component_description: Adapt presentation style and language to suit a specific audience and purpose

cc_matches.description: Present information, findings, and supporting evidence such that listeners can follow the line of reasoning and the organization, development, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and present the relationships between information and ideas efficiently as well as to interact and collaborate with others.
Create audio recordings of stories or poems; add drawings or other visual displays to stories or recounts of experiences when appropriate to clarify ideas, thoughts, and feelings.
